title: Armada black box record (record.json)
description: Schema of record.json, the versioned BlackBoxRecord of a black box entry, plus the entry, summary, object, chunk, manifest, digest, note and event payload shapes in $defs. Generated from the C# models by BlackBoxSchemaGenerator; see docs/BLACKBOX_SCHEMA.md. Readers ignore unknown properties and read unknown enum values as Unknown.

BlackBoxAction.title: BlackBoxAction
BlackBoxAction.description: A machine-readable action: an MCP tool name and its arguments.

arguments.description: Tool arguments as text; when the action runs, true, false and whole numbers become JSON booleans and numbers.

BlackBoxAnalysis.title: BlackBoxAnalysis
BlackBoxAnalysis.description: Analysis section: advisor findings. Every claim carries a rule id.

summary.description: Plain-language summary (3 to 6 sentences), or null.

summaryIsModelWritten.description: Whether Summary was written by a model (labeled model-written).

BlackBoxAttempt.title: BlackBoxAttempt
BlackBoxAttempt.description: A prior attempt of the subject, or a link in its rescue chain.

entryId.description: Black box entry of the attempt, or null.

missionId.description: Mission of the attempt (differs for a rescue).

BlackBoxClassification.title: BlackBoxClassification
BlackBoxClassification.description: Classification section: the failure kind, the raw reason and the suspected cause.

kind.description: Failure kind (voyages use the root mission's kind).

rawReason.description: Raw failure reason (redacted, at most 8000 characters).

suspectedCause.description: Suspected cause from the failure-cause rules.

causeRuleId.description: Rule that assigned the cause, or null.

isRecoverable.description: Whether the failure is recoverable, or null when unknown.

isTransient.description: Whether the failure looks transient, or null when unknown.

BlackBoxCommitRef.title: BlackBoxCommitRef
BlackBoxCommitRef.description: A commit referenced by a black box record.

BlackBoxConfigRecommendation.title: BlackBoxConfigRecommendation
BlackBoxConfigRecommendation.description: A configuration change that could have prevented the failure.

id.description: Stable recommendation id: the rule id in lower case, a dot and a key (for example bbx-land-001.landing-mode).

BlackBoxConfigValue.title: BlackBoxConfigValue
BlackBoxConfigValue.description: One effective configuration value and where it came from.

value.description: Value as text (redacted when secret), or null when unset.

BlackBoxConfiguration.title: BlackBoxConfiguration
BlackBoxConfiguration.description: Configuration section: effective values that shaped the failure, each with its source.

BlackBoxConflict.title: BlackBoxConflict
BlackBoxConflict.description: Conflict section: conflicted files and directories and the missions that collided.

isConflict.description: Whether the failure is a merge conflict.

conflictedDirectories.description: Conflicted files rolled up to directories, with counts.

conflictingMissions.description: Missions whose landed commits touched the same files.

targetCommitsSinceStart.description: Commits on the target since the mission started.

targetCommitTotal.description: Total target commits since start before capping.

BlackBoxConflictingMission.title: BlackBoxConflictingMission
BlackBoxConflictingMission.description: A mission whose work collided with the failed mission.

missionId.description: Mission, or null for a commit made outside Armada.

landedUtc.description: When the commit landed (UTC), or null.

isOutsideArmada.description: Whether the commit has no Armada-Mission-Id trailer.

author.description: Commit author (for commits outside Armada), or null.

reason.description: Why: Manual, Purge, Expired, Evicted, Cascade.

BlackBoxDiffStat.title: BlackBoxDiffStat
BlackBoxDiffStat.description: Diff stat of the mission's change.

BlackBoxDigest.title: BlackBoxDigest
BlackBoxDigest.description: Compact view of a black box entry (about 2 KB) for MCP get_blackbox format=summary: identity, where, how, status before and after, why, and the top recovery paths.

captureMode.description: Capture mode (Sweeper and Backfill are lower fidelity).

sourceFile.description: Source file of the failure site.

mechanism.description: One-line mechanism (exception, exit code, failing command or git operation).

BlackBoxDirectoryCount.title: BlackBoxDirectoryCount
BlackBoxDirectoryCount.description: A directory and how many conflicted files it holds.

directory.description: Directory (repository-relative, forward slashes; empty for the root).

BlackBoxDownloadManifest.title: BlackBoxDownloadManifest
BlackBoxDownloadManifest.description: manifest.json inside a black box .zip download: the entry, its schema version and every object with name, content type, size and SHA-256.

armadaVersion.description: Armada version that captured the entry.

objects.description: Objects in the archive (stored SHA-256 of the encoded bytes; the archive holds the decoded bytes).

missingObjects.description: Objects whose bytes could not be read.

BlackBoxEntry.title: BlackBoxEntry
BlackBoxEntry.description: A black box entry: the index row (blackbox_entries) for one captured mission or voyage failure. The index is always in the database whatever the storage target; only object bytes move between targets. Record is populated only by reads that ask for it.

missionId.description: Mission, or null for a voyage entry.

missionTitle.description: Denormalized mission (or voyage) title, kept after the mission is purged.

attempt.description: Attempt number for the subject, starting at 1.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the subject's current entry (one per subject).

supersedesId.description: The previous entry for the same subject, or null.

fingerprint.description: Failure-mode fingerprint (64 hex characters), or null.

resolutionLink.description: Link to what fixed it: mission id, commit, PR or issue URL (at most 1000 characters).

pinned.description: Pinned entries are never expired or evicted.

storageTarget.description: Where the entry's object bytes are stored.

storagePrefix.description: Object key prefix for external targets, or null.

totalBytes.description: Stored (compressed) size of the entry's objects.

armadaCommit.description: Armada commit that captured it, or null.

reasonExcerpt.description: Redacted reason excerpt for lists and search (at most 1000 characters).

summary.description: Analysis summary excerpt for lists and search (at most 2000 characters), or null.

lastError.description: Last enrichment or storage error (redacted), or null.

nextAttemptUtc.description: When the sweeper may retry enrichment (UTC), or null.

expiresUtc.description: When the entry expires (UTC); null when pinned or kept forever.

record.description: The record (record.json), populated only when a read asks for it; never stored in the row.

BlackBoxEntrySummary.title: BlackBoxEntrySummary
BlackBoxEntrySummary.description: Short form of a black box entry for lists.

BlackBoxEventRef.title: BlackBoxEventRef
BlackBoxEventRef.description: An event referenced by a record.

BlackBoxEvidenceIndex.title: BlackBoxEvidenceIndex
BlackBoxEvidenceIndex.description: Evidence section: names, sizes and excerpts of the evidence objects, plus small structured evidence.

BlackBoxEvidenceItem.title: BlackBoxEvidenceItem
BlackBoxEvidenceItem.description: One evidence object listed in a record.

truncated.description: Whether the object was cut (head and tail kept).

originalBytes.description: Original size before cutting, or null.

ruleId.description: Rule that produced it (for example BBX-LAND-003).

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence (section paths or object names).

BlackBoxGcReport.title: BlackBoxGcReport
BlackBoxGcReport.description: Report of one black box garbage collection run (also the blackbox.gc_completed event payload).

dryRun.description: Whether this was a dry run.

cascaded.description: Entries deleted with their vessel or mission.

retriedDeletes.description: Entries left Deleting by an earlier run and finished now.

failures.description: Entries whose delete failed (left Deleting, retried next run).

candidateEntryIds.description: Up to 100 entry ids deleted (or that a dry run would delete).

BlackBoxImprovement.title: BlackBoxImprovement
BlackBoxImprovement.description: An Armada behavior change that could address the failure.

BlackBoxMechanism.title: BlackBoxMechanism
BlackBoxMechanism.description: Mechanism section: how a failure happened.

runtimeFailureKind.description: How the runtime classified the exit, or null.

commandExitCode.description: Failing command's exit code, or null.

commandOutputTail.description: Tail of the failing command's output (at most 8000 characters).

gitOperation.description: Git operation that failed, or null.

gitStderrTail.description: Tail of git stderr (at most 4000 characters).

BlackBoxNote.title: BlackBoxNote
BlackBoxNote.description: A note on a black box entry by an operator, an agent, Ask Armada or Armada (blackbox_notes).

BlackBoxObjectChunk.title: BlackBoxObjectChunk
BlackBoxObjectChunk.description: A chunk of a black box object, for paging through large objects (MCP read_blackbox_object: at most 64 KB per call).

offset.description: Offset of this chunk in the uncompressed object.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next chunk, or null at the end.

encoding.description: utf-8 for text objects, base64 otherwise.

BlackBoxObjectSummary.title: BlackBoxObjectSummary
BlackBoxObjectSummary.description: Short form of a black box object for lists.

BlackBoxRecord.title: BlackBoxRecord
BlackBoxRecord.description: The content of a black box entry's record.json: a versioned forensic snapshot of one mission or voyage failure, deserialized into typed classes (never read through JsonElement). A section that was not captured is null; readers render whatever sections exist. Every string is capped and every collection bounded (BlackBoxLimits).

schemaVersion.description: Record schema version (BlackBoxLimits.SchemaVersion for this build).

rulesVersion.description: Advisor rules version that produced the Analysis section (0 when not analyzed).

state.description: Processing state when the record was last written.

subject.description: Identity of the failed mission or voyage.

status.description: Status before and after, and the timeline.

classification.description: Kind, raw reason and suspected cause.

workspace.description: Dock, worktree, branch and target state; null until captured or enriched.

conflict.description: Conflicted files, directories and conflicting missions; null when not a conflict or not yet enriched.

scope.description: Scoped, out-of-scope and boundary files; null when not applicable.

configuration.description: Effective configuration that shaped the failure.

attempts.description: Prior attempts and the rescue chain, oldest first.

redaction.description: Which redaction rules fired and how often (never the values).

truncation.description: Fields that were cut, with their original sizes, and capture notes.

BlackBoxRecoveryPath.title: BlackBoxRecoveryPath
BlackBoxRecoveryPath.description: A ranked recovery path with exact commands and a machine-readable action.

id.description: Stable path id: the rule id in lower case, a dot and a key (for example bbx-land-001.stash-retry).

dataLossRisk.description: Whether any step can lose data (requires acknowledgeDataLoss).

dryRun.description: Whether this was a dry run.

recommendationId.description: Recommendation applied, when the run applied a configuration recommendation (PathId then holds the same id).

stepsRun.description: Steps the run executed (0 for a dry run).

userId.description: User who ran it, or null.

BlackBoxRecoveryStep.title: BlackBoxRecoveryStep
BlackBoxRecoveryStep.description: One step of a recovery path.

action.description: Machine-readable action, or null for a manual step.

dataLossRisk.description: Whether the step can lose data.

BlackBoxRedaction.title: BlackBoxRedaction
BlackBoxRedaction.description: Redaction report: rule names and counts, never values.

BlackBoxRedactionRuleCount.title: BlackBoxRedactionRuleCount
BlackBoxRedactionRuleCount.description: A redaction rule and how often it fired.

BlackBoxRelated.title: BlackBoxRelated
BlackBoxRelated.description: Related section: fingerprint, similar entries and cascade.

occurrencesLast30Days.description: Entries with the same fingerprint in the last 30 days.

BlackBoxScope.title: BlackBoxScope
BlackBoxScope.description: Scope section: the mission's scoped files and what fell outside them.

scopedFiles.description: Scoped files from the mission brief.

BlackBoxSectionResult.title: BlackBoxSectionResult
BlackBoxSectionResult.description: One section of an entry's record. Record carries only the requested section (other sections are null).

record.description: Record with only the requested section populated.

BlackBoxSimilarEntry.title: BlackBoxSimilarEntry
BlackBoxSimilarEntry.description: An earlier entry with the same failure mode.

BlackBoxSite.title: BlackBoxSite
BlackBoxSite.description: Site section: where a failure happened, down to the Armada source line.

hostKind.description: Which host the failure happened on.

armadaCommit.description: Armada build commit, or null when unknown.

BlackBoxStatusChange.title: BlackBoxStatusChange
BlackBoxStatusChange.description: Status section: the subject's status before and after the failure write, and its timeline.

before.description: Status before the failure write (MissionStatusEnum or VoyageStatusEnum name), or null when unknown.

timeline.description: Status changes in the attempt, oldest first.

BlackBoxStatusTimelineEntry.title: BlackBoxStatusTimelineEntry
BlackBoxStatusTimelineEntry.description: One status change in a black box status timeline.

source.description: What set it (event type or component), or null.

BlackBoxSubject.title: BlackBoxSubject
BlackBoxSubject.description: Identity section of a black box record: the failed mission or voyage and everything it ran with.

missionId.description: Mission (msn_ prefix), or null for a voyage entry.

title.description: Mission title (or voyage title for a voyage entry).

vesselRepoUrl.description: Vessel repository URL (credentials redacted), or null.

captainModel.description: Model the captain ran, or null.

persona.description: Persona the mission routed as, or null.

harborId.description: Harbor the dock ran on, or null for the Admiral host.

stageOutcomeId.description: Stage outcome of the attempt, or null.

attempt.description: Attempt number of this entry for the subject, starting at 1.

isRescue.description: Whether the mission is a rescue.

BlackBoxTriageVerdict.title: BlackBoxTriageVerdict
BlackBoxTriageVerdict.description: Triage verdict with the rule votes behind it.

BlackBoxTruncation.title: BlackBoxTruncation
BlackBoxTruncation.description: Truncation report: what was cut and why. Nothing is dropped silently.

timedOut.description: Whether capture ran out of its time budget and wrote a partial entry.

notes.description: Capture notes (timeouts, lower-fidelity capture, missing facts).

BlackBoxVoyageRollup.title: BlackBoxVoyageRollup
BlackBoxVoyageRollup.description: Voyage section (voyage entries only): missions by status, failed entries, cascade root and settlement.

failedMissionEntryIds.description: Current black box entries of the failed missions.

cascadeRootEntryId.description: Root failed mission's entry, or null.

settlementRule.description: Settlement rule that decided the voyage, or null.

BlackBoxWorkspace.title: BlackBoxWorkspace
BlackBoxWorkspace.description: Workspace section: dock, worktree, branch and target state at the failure.

worktreeExists.description: Whether the worktree existed, or null when unknown.

startCommit.description: Commit the mission started from, or null.

startCommitSource.description: Where the start commit came from (Mission, DockAnchors, DockStartFile), or null.

targetTipAtStart.description: Target tip when the mission started, or null.

targetTipAtFailure.description: Target tip at the failure, or null.

commitsBehindTarget.description: Commits the branch is behind the target, or null.

commitsAheadOfStart.description: Commits the branch is ahead of its start, or null.

checkoutDirty.description: Whether the target checkout had uncommitted tracked changes, or null.

harborLinkState.description: Harbor link state for Harbor-hosted docks, or null.

harborLastSeenUtc.description: When the Harbor was last seen (UTC), or null.

StageCheckResult.title: StageCheckResult
StageCheckResult.description: The result of a stage check: whether the stage's work was verified, and when it was not, why.

reason.description: Why the check ended with this status.

commands.description: The commands the check ran or would have run, in order.

unitTestScope.description: Which unit-test command the check chose (full or abbreviated), or null when the profile had no unit-test command.

failedCommand.description: The command that failed or timed out, or null.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the failed command, or null.

preExistingFailures.description: Commands that failed on the stage's starting commit too, so they did not block the stage.

failureMessage.description: The note sent back to the captain describing a failure or an unverified check, or null.

durationMs.description: How long the check took, in milliseconds.

isBlocking.description: Whether the check blocks the stage. Only a confirmed Failed result blocks, even without a failure message; CouldNotRun and TimedOut are unverified warnings that never count as passing.
